source_boundary: Official Eona and Organa system context plus independent secondary location guides. Coordinates are owned schematic placements, not copied game pins, not imported map coordinates and not first-hand verified routes.

EONAS_LEGACY.note: Meadow of Beginnings and Dragonrise Basin received a stop-loss source recheck; no VIDEO_VERIFIED or OFFICIAL_VERIFIED individual-location evidence was found.

ORGANA_STATUE.conflict_note: Multiple public guide sources list 13 Statue of Organa locations; prior public-map/source inventory retained an ecosystem-level 13 vs 14 conflict. This sprint publishes only five individually corroborated Organa markers and does not assert a complete set count.

markers.name: Eona's Legacy - Meadow of Beginnings
markers.source_summary: Official sources confirm the Eona system and full-set achievement; a stop-loss recheck found no individual official/video location proof, while two independent secondary guides align on the Meadow missing-cog route.
markers.description: Start at Alvwyn beside Eona's Legacy, follow the marked hideout objective, recover the missing cog, and return to the tower. Schematic placement is approximate.

evidence.note: Confirms Eona's Legacy activation, Alvwyn prerequisite, fog removal, warp availability, and wind path behavior.
Confirms a tracked achievement for activating all of Eona's Legacy, but not individual coordinates.
Lists Meadow of Beginnings as the first Eona location with a missing-cog route and approximate map context.
Independently matches the Meadow missing-cog route and completion loop.

markers.name: Eona's Legacy - Shadowed Woods
markers.source_summary: Multiple secondary sources align on a web-covered Eona tower and Aria/fire solution; public video stills exist, but no direct timestamped map-view video was verified.
markers.description: Look for the web-covered Eona structure in Shadowed Woods, use Aria or fire/explosive damage to clear the obstruction, then return to the tower interaction.

evidence.note: Confirms the Eona system and activation result, but not this individual tower.
Lists Shadowed Woods and the spider-web/fire interaction in the complete Eona set.
Independently matches Shadowed Woods, the web-covered tower, and the Aria/explosive solution.
Shows article-embedded gameplay stills credited to YouTube/WoW Quests, but no direct video URL and timestamp were verified in this sprint.

markers.name: Eona's Legacy - Dragonrise Basin
markers.source_summary: Two independent secondary guides and a source-linked map reference align on Dragonrise Basin as a platform-trial Eona location; no first-hand, official individual-location or timestamped video route was verified.
markers.description: Speak with Alvwyn near the Dragonrise Basin tower, follow the marked platform-trial entrance, finish the route, then return to activate Eona's Legacy.

evidence.note: Confirms the Eona activation system and fog/warp outcome, but not Dragonrise Basin's exact placement.
Lists Dragonrise Basin as an approximate, source-linked Eona marker. Coordinates were not copied.
Lists Dragonrise Basin as a platform-trial Eona location.
Independently matches Dragonrise Basin, Alvwyn, and the platform-trial route.

markers.description: Use the statue's Shaded Tree Hill area and nearby collapsed wall, water-side bushes, enemy camp and southeast cliff as approximate anchors. Schematic placement is not an exact pin.

evidence.note: Confirms Statue of Organa restoration is a tracked system, but not this individual location.
Lists Shaded Tree Hill as an Organa statue location with nearby restoration-piece landmarks.
